source_row.rationale: Early identification and treatment of vision problems in young children is important because the visual system is still developing during early childhood, and conditions such as amblyopia ("lazy eye") can become permanent if not corrected within a critical developmental window, underscoring the value of routine vision screening as part of pediatric preventive care.
